newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end flat, rate woes remain.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end flat, rate woes remain.

text.p: Brazil stocks closed little changed on Friday after falling earlier amid volatility in the interest rate futures market, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most active shares ended at 9,422 points, up 0.04 percent. Market turnover totalled 614.5 million reais ($579.7 million).
Analysts said markets were still weighing this week's decision by Brazil's Central Bank to leave its basic interest rate (TBC) for May unchanged from April's 1.58 percent.
